services.name: Rental
services.desc: Tamarack is a cozy, fully furnished housekeeping cottage offering quiet, seclusion, and access to the shore of Dodge Pond with a private dock. It was once the home of Dr. Reich and his family. Tamarack has three bedrooms and sleeps eight. It is equipped with a full kitchen and fiber optic wifi. Pets are welcome at an additional charge. Located midway between Rangeley and Oquossoc, the cottage provides easy access to dining and shopping in both towns, all of the Rangeley Lakes, the Appalachian Trail, Mingo Springs Golf Course, Saddleback Ski Area, cross-country skiing, and miles of groomed snowmobile trails. Saddleback Ski Area - 10.3 miles Mingo Springs Golf Course - 1 mile Cross-country
